criteria.criterion: Pooled H2H log loss strictly better than reference (a) — outright-Close market proxy (field-normalized, pairwise)
Pooled H2H log loss strictly better than reference (b) — OWGR-points-implied reference rating
Calibration error (mean |predicted - realized| in probability deciles) <= 0.05

criteria.result: NOT RUN (volume material present: 3912 / 3561 / 3442 player-rows in test seasons 2023 / 2024 / 2025 across 30 / 30 / 29 unique events)

gaps.gap: Reference (b) cannot be constructed: OWGR weekly points for the 2023-2025 event weeks are not obtainable free in pinnable form. owgr.com's archive PDF paths now serve a 147450-byte Next.js HTML shell (HTTP 200, text/html) instead of the PDF; the Wayback Machine holds only the http->https 301 redirect stubs (identical digest 3I42H3S6NNFQ2MSVX7XZKYAYSCX5QBYJ) for the weekly PDF URLs and rate-blocks downloads (429). The design's Leg-1 PASS requires beating BOTH references; with (b) unconstructable the screen cannot be run or passed as written.

The design's own admission precondition is unmet: design section 7 names an 'Admission gap (blocker for Leg 1)' — the DataGolf free archive needs a pin/hash admission before any screen runs on it. This attempt's 780 hash-pinned page pulls (dg_pages_manifest.json) plus coverage analysis are the admission raw material; no admission record exists yet, and creating one is a separate governed act.
